description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractQueryLiveCommand that serves as a base for specific live command implementations related to querying 'things' within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It wraps a ThingQueryCommand and implements methods to retrieve thing identifiers, selected fields, and categorizes the command as a query.

classes.name: AbstractQueryLiveCommand
classes.description: An abstract class providing foundational functionality for live query commands that involve querying 'things', wrapping a ThingQueryCommand, and implementing the ThingQueryCommand interface.

methods.name: AbstractQueryLiveCommand
methods.description: Constructor initializing the command with the wrapped ThingQueryCommand instance.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the 'thing' entity associated with this command.

methods.name: getSelectedFields
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the fields selected for this query.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of this command, which is 'QUERY'.
